sections.title: source/testplan/testplan-introduction.xml

summary.text: The FHIR R5 build-source introduction to TestPlan. Scope and Usage: TestPlan is a canonical resource defining how a system or specification is to be tested, covering the business and planning side around TestScript, which handles part of execution. It describes purpose, dependencies, scope, test environment, framework and output, and holds test cases with entry criteria (preconditions), exit criteria and test data or instructions for obtaining it, supporting traditional and agile (TDD, BDD) testing. Test plans can depend on or extend others for reuse, e.g. a national specification requiring conformance to IHE profiles, WHO datasets, ISO IDMP and OpenHIE. Boundaries: TestPlan says what to test and is maintained from a business perspective, TestScript says how to test; a TestPlan can be tied to any canonical resource, including a whole ImplementationGuide or some of its artifacts.

sections.title: source/testplan/structuredefinition-TestPlan.xml

summary.text: The FHIR 5.0.0 StructureDefinition for TestPlan (draft, maturity 0, FHIR Infrastructure, a specialisation of CanonicalResource described as 'a plan for executing testing on an artifact or specifications'). Besides the canonical metadata elements (url, identifier, version, versionAlgorithm, name, title, a required status, experimental, date, publisher, contact, description, useContext, jurisdiction, purpose, copyright, copyrightLabel) it defines category, scope (what is tested), testTools, dependency (description and predecessor), exitCriteria, and testCase with sequence, scope, dependency, testRun (narrative, or a script with language such as gherkin or testscript and source), testData (a required type such as 'synthea', content and source) and assertion (type, object, result). It also carries the cnl-0 and cnl-1 warning constraints on name and url.

summary.text: The build-source CodeSystem testplan-counttype (version 5.0.0, draft, trial-use, maturity 0), named and titled InventoryCountType and described as 'the type of count'. Its two concepts are about inventory reports, not test plans: snapshot (current quantities at hand) and difference (items added or subtracted since a previous count).

The build-source CodeSystem testplan-status (TestPlanStatus, version 5.0.0, draft, trial-use, maturity 0), 'the status of the TestPlan', with four concepts whose definitions speak of a report: draft, requested (an inventory report requested with no data yet), active (submitted as current) and entered-in-error (withdrawn after a previous final release).

sections.title: source/testplan/testplan-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml

summary.text: The build-source exceptions to TestPlan's mapping onto the workflow Definition pattern. Thirteen elements diverge from the pattern, mostly in wording of short names, definitions, comments or requirements: url, identifier, version, name, title (summary flag differs), status, experimental, date, description, useContext, jurisdiction, purpose and copyright. Thirteen pattern elements are unmapped, among them derivedFromCanonical, derivedFromUri, approvalDate, lastReviewDate, effectivePeriod, copyrightLabel, versionAlgorithm, subject, product, code, performerType, partOf and topic, all with reason 'Unknown'.
